capabilities.description: Request ebooks by ISBN and follow their progress in Bookwarehouse. Served by an installation whose content is ebooks.

queued.label: Searching
queued.detail: Bookwarehouse is searching for the ebook.

fields.label: Allow PDF
fields.description: Let people request PDFs, not only EPUBs.

fields.label: Ebook format
fields.description: Leave unset to use the installation's requested ebook format.

capabilities.description: Find a requested audiobook on AudiobookBay through Bookwarehouse, download it with Bookwarehouse's torrent client and follow it until Bookwarehouse imports it. Served by an installation whose content is audiobooks; needs a Curator key.

downloading.label: Downloading
downloading.detail: Bookwarehouse is downloading and importing the audiobook.

global_config_schema.title: Bookwarehouse connection
global_config_schema.description: Read ebooks (EPUB and PDF) or audiobooks straight from Bookwarehouse, and order the ones people request. Files are checked and kept in a size-limited private cache.

fields.label: Content
fields.description: Ebooks and audiobooks each need their own connection with a different source ID. The size limits apply to ebooks only.

fields.label: Bookwarehouse address
fields.description: The address you open Bookwarehouse at, including any path. Don’t add /api/v1.

fields.label: Request API key (Curator)
fields.description: Audiobook requests add torrents in Bookwarehouse, which needs a key with the Curator role. Leave empty to use the API key above.

fields.label: Requested ebook format
fields.description: The format ebook requests ask Bookwarehouse for.

fields.label: Allow unencrypted HTTP
fields.description: Only on a network you trust: over http the API key is sent unencrypted.

fields.label: Source ID
fields.description: A short, unique name for this connection, like bookwarehouse.

fields.label: Source name
fields.description: What admins see for this connection.

fields.label: Largest book (bytes)
fields.description: Bigger ebooks are skipped. The default, 134217728, is 128 MB.

fields.label: Cache size (bytes)
fields.description: How much space the ebook cache may use. The default, 536870912, is 512 MB.
